hadur2.core.model.BattleFacts

Packages that use BattleFacts
Package
Description
hadur2
The Robocode adapter: the only code in Hadur 2 that sees the engine.
hadur2.core
Hadur 2's core: the whole of the robot's strategy, as plain Java that never sees the Robocode engine.
hadur2.core.model
The values the core is made of: what crosses the hexagonal boundary each tick, the robot states and their logs, and the waves the duel's gun and movement learn from.
hadur2.core.replay
Recorded battles as text, and a driver that replays them through a fresh core (CORE-2).
hadur2.core.role
The role contract's routing (A1 of the architecture evolution, ROLE-1 to ROLE-4): which strand drives the robot this tick.
